notes: Name attested in Arabic grimoire tradition (Shams al-ma'arif lineage) as the jinn king of Wednesday/Mercury ("Two Thunders"); row-correspondence Hod/Mercury->Barqan is PONTIFEX-constructed. ptk breakdown: ب2+ر200+ق100+ا1+ن50; unknown() clean. column_title: Kings and Princes of the Jinn
notes: Name attested in Arabic grimoire tradition as the jinn king of Monday/Moon (Murra ibn al-Harith); variant: some accounts give al-Abyad (the White One) for Monday — noted not proposed. Row-correspondence Yesod/Moon->Murrah is PONTIFEX-constructed. ptk breakdown: م40+ر200; unknown()=['ة'] — ptk ARABIC_ABJAD lacks ta marbuta; skip is VISIBLE not silent; standard abjad ة=5 gives 245 (spread reported per doctrine). Digit-sum 11 only on the 245 variant — chance-flagged.

column_title: Kings and Princes of the Jinn
